subject.name: Security Management Specialists
subject.summary: Security management specialists (O*NET 13-1199.07) assess an organization's physical security threats, design and improve security systems and processes, conduct audits, propose countermeasures and follow up on them. U.S. wages and employment are available only as the broad 13-1199 aggregate and cannot be treated as standalone data for this occupation.
